where the handed note sits in the rendered prompt

summary: A continuing note is written and never read back: the next tick on the entry sees the prior-attempt record and nothing the last tick said
acceptance: a continuing note standing for the assigned entry rides that tick's build prompt beside the prior-attempt record; with none standing, nothing is rendered in its place
tests: a continuing note standing for the assigned entry rides the build prompt
pins: a build prompt for an entry with no standing continuing note renders no note block
notes: The note says what landed, what is next and where to look; handing it back is what makes the segment a handoff rather than a lost tick. Read from the tick's own tree at the path the args already name, never a path composed a second time.
